name: patchelf
description: 用于修改ELF二进制文件的工具，可调整解释器、SONAME、RPATH等属性，无需重新编译链接。
syntax: patchelf [--set-interpreter FILENAME] [--page-size SIZE] [--print-interpreter] [--print-soname] [--set-soname SONAME] [--set-rpath RPATH] [--add-rpath RPATH] [--remove-rpath] [--shrink-rpath] [--allowed-rpath-prefixes PREFIXES] [--print-rpath] [--force-rpath] [--add-needed LIBRARY] [--remove-needed LIBRARY] [--replace-needed LIBRARY NEW_LIBRARY] [--print-needed] [--no-default-lib] [--no-sort] [--clear-symbol-version SYMBOL] [--add-debug-tag] [--output FILE] [--debug] [--version] FILENAME...

options.description: Set the interpreter of the ELF file to FILENAME
Set the page size to SIZE
Print the interpreter of the ELF file
Prints 'DT_SONAME' entry of .dynamic section. Raises an error if DT_SONAME doesn't exist
Sets 'DT_SONAME' entry to SONAME.
Set the RPATH of the ELF file to RPATH
Add RPATH to the ELF file's existing RPATH
Remove the RPATH from the ELF file
Shrink the RPATH of the ELF file
With '--shrink-rpath', reject rpath entries not starting with the allowed prefix
Print the RPATH of the ELF file
Force the use of RPATH instead of RUNPATH
Add a dependency on LIBRARY to the ELF file
Remove the dependency on LIBRARY from the ELF file
Replace dependency on LIBRARY with NEW_LIBRARY in the ELF file
Print the libraries that the ELF file depends on
Do not use the default library search path
Do not sort program+section headers; useful for debugging patchelf.
Clear the version information for SYMBOL
Add a debug tag to the ELF file
Write the modified ELF file to FILE instead of overwriting the original
Enable debug output
Print the version of patchelf
